quote.translation: As possibility increases, contingency decreases, and as contingency increases, possibility decreases.

regions.text: 可能性増大の極は偶然性減少の極と一致する。それがすなはち必然性である。また偶然性増大の極は可能性減少の極と一致する。それが不可能性である。今遮べた考察を左の圖形で表はすことができる。

quote.translation: The extreme of the increase of possibility coincides with the extreme of the decrease of contingency, and this is necessity; the extreme of the increase of contingency coincides with the extreme of the decrease of possibility, and this is impossibility.

regions.text: で表はすことができる。この點からして第一章第五節で

quote.translation: What has just been said can be represented by the following figure 〔Figure 6〕.

regions.text: この點からして第一章第五節で取扱つた例外的偶然の有つ特殊な位置が理解される。

quote.translation: From this we can understand the special position held by the exceptional contingency treated in Chapter 1, section 5.

regions.text: 例外偶然とは徹表が非本質性を有つたもので可能性含有量の最も少ない偶然である。従つて最も題著な偶然である。

quote.translation: Exceptional contingency is the contingent in which the mark is non-essential and the content of possibility is at its smallest, and it is consequently the contingent at its most conspicuous.

regions.text: その反對に本質的徴表と見られてゐるものは可能生増大の極、必然性に準するもので概念の構成的内容として法則の低値を有つてるる。クローパーが三葉を有つてゐることは断やうな本質的微表が備はつてゐることである。

quote.translation: What is regarded as an essential mark, by contrast, lies at the extreme of the increase of possibility, approximating to necessity, and as the constitutive content of the concept it has the value of a law.

regions.text: 備はつてゐることである。三葉といふことはクローバーの概

quote.translation: That clover has three leaves means that it possesses an essential mark of this kind.

regions.text: 三葉といふことはクローバーの概念にとつて嚴密に云へば必然とは云へないが、可能性増大の極限として準必然約のものである。

quote.translation: Strictly speaking, being three-leaved cannot be called necessary for the concept of clover, but as the limit of the increase of possibility it is quasi-necessary.

regions.text: それに反してクローバーが四葉第三章燉接昀偶然三一m

quote.translation: That a clover has four leaves, on the other hand, is an exception, the contingent containing extremely little possibility, one that grazes the domain of the impossible, and this is why the four-leaved clover stands out as something especially contingent.
